## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, ownership boundary and change.

## Validation

List commands actually executed, environment, results and skipped checks.
For performance work include frozen seeds/configuration, raw evidence location/hash,
run-level uncertainty, failures/deadline attainment, overhead and regressions.

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe protocol/configuration changes, privilege effects, rollback and unresolved risks.
Identify third-party source/dependencies and their provenance.
